Support & SLA

If you have any questions or need help, please visit Azure Support and select self-help service or any other method to contact us for support.

Azure Policy is a free service, therefore, it does not have a financially backed SLA.To learn more about the details of our Service Level Agreement, please visit the Service Level Agreements page.
